acceptance_criteria.description: Sign-in obtains a CSRF token with no-store/same-origin credentials and posts only email/password with the required CSRF header and same-origin credentials.
Sign-in maps authentication failures to safe generic feedback and handles unavailable responses without exposing account state.
Only active server-authoritative USER and ADMIN projections route to /app and /admin; inactive accounts do not route.
The sign-in UI prevents duplicate submissions and exposes loading/error feedback through the existing polite live region without starting registration behavior or changing server code.
